title: Conventional Display Software and Measurement Workload Corpus

reference_sources.title: W3C CSS Color Module Level 4 sRGB transfer functions
ITU-R BT.2100-3 (2025)
reference_sources.use: PQ/HLG transfer and HDR signal semantics

reference_sources.title: VESA DisplayHDR CTS 1.2 criteria
reference_sources.use: physical HDR luminance/color/temporal benchmark alignment; not certification

reference_sources.title: VESA ClearMR compliance test framework
reference_sources.use: motion blur metric method when exact CTS conditions are met

evidence_lanes.software_math: Known-answer equations and numerical error/domain checks; no physical claim.
evidence_lanes.software_synthetic: Deterministic synthetic work/load; no physical or human-perception claim.
evidence_lanes.physical_measurement: Requires named device, pinned mode/protocol, calibrated instrument, raw data and uncertainty.
evidence_lanes.human_task_study: Requires consent, preregistered task/endpoints, governed data and statistical reporting.

cases.title: sRGB transfer-function anchor points
cases.expected_behavior: Match the piecewise sRGB decode reference at the defined anchors within a declared numerical tolerance; keep the transfer threshold and branch explicit.
cases.claim_limit: This qualifies transfer math only, not a physical monitor.

cases.title: sRGB encode/decode round-trip
cases.expected_behavior: Decode then encode in-gamut values and preserve the encoded input within the declared numerical tolerance.
cases.claim_limit: Round-trip correctness does not establish colorimetric accuracy on a display.

cases.title: Reject invalid sRGB inputs
cases.expected_behavior: Out-of-domain values are rejected; non-finite values never become a plausible finite color output.
cases.claim_limit: The fixture tests software input handling only.

cases.title: Relative luminance from sRGB primaries
cases.expected_behavior: Linearize channels before computing normalized relative luminance with the declared Rec.709/sRGB coefficients.
cases.claim_limit: Output is normalized relative luminance Y, not absolute luminance.

cases.title: PQ encoding at 100 cd/m²
cases.expected_behavior: PQ encode the stated luminance and decode it back within the tolerance selected from the pinned BT.2100 implementation.
cases.claim_limit: Computed transfer values are not measured panel output.

cases.title: PQ high-luminance anchors and domain
cases.expected_behavior: Match the pinned PQ reference at dark, typical white, highlight and nominal upper-range anchors; reject out-of-domain luminance.
cases.claim_limit: Does not qualify mastering, tone mapping, or panel brightness.

cases.title: HLG scene OETF lower-branch boundary
cases.expected_behavior: Match the pinned HLG scene OETF on the square-root branch and immediately around the branch point.
cases.claim_limit: This is the scene OETF only, not the display-side HLG OOTF/EOTF.

cases.title: HLG scene OETF logarithmic branch and white
cases.expected_behavior: Match the pinned logarithmic branch and canonical white endpoint.
cases.claim_limit: Normalized HLG signal is not display luminance.

cases.title: HLG OETF monotonicity grid
cases.expected_behavior: Output is finite, within the declared signal domain and monotonically non-decreasing.
cases.claim_limit: Mathematical monotonicity is not perceived HDR-quality evidence.

cases.title: Reject transfer-function metadata mismatch
cases.expected_behavior: Reject or require an explicit, versioned conversion when signal metadata and transform/primaries do not agree.
cases.claim_limit: The test does not establish OS/color-management correctness.

cases.title: Tone-map order and highlight-detail synthetic test
cases.expected_behavior: Candidate tone mapping reports explicit input/output domains and preserves declared ordering/target detail constraints without falsely claiming a fixed physical luminance.
cases.claim_limit: Synthetic tone-map result is not a hardware HDR measurement.

cases.title: Neutral ramp monotonicity and banding diagnostics
cases.expected_behavior: Report monotonicity, distinct output levels and banding-risk measures separately for reference and candidate paths.
failure_modes: banding metric mislabeled as human perception
cases.claim_limit: A software banding proxy is not a subjective visual-quality study.

cases.title: Near-black monotonicity and black-crush pattern
cases.expected_behavior: The digital pattern encodes the intended distinct low-level steps; measured panel luminance must later be checked independently.
metrics: measured luminance step order when instrumented
failure_modes: confusion of encoded values with measured luminance
cases.claim_limit: Software result does not establish physical black-crush performance.

cases.title: Small highlight with low average-picture-level background
cases.expected_behavior: Produce a deterministic input pattern and compare candidate tone mapping without clipping the surrounding reference details.
cases.claim_limit: This mirrors a pattern concept but is not the official DisplayHDR CTS pattern.

cases.title: DisplayHDR 8% center-patch peak luminance
cases.expected_behavior: Measure peak luminance, device mode, instrument/calibration and all official pattern conditions for the selected tier.
cases.claim_limit: This is a planned physical test, not VESA certification.

cases.title: Full-screen HDR flash peak
cases.expected_behavior: Measure short-duration full-field luminance and rise behavior per the declared standard profile.
failure_modes: using center-patch peak as full-screen peak
cases.claim_limit: No certification claim without official conformance procedures.

cases.title: Sustained full-screen luminance and thermal behavior
cases.expected_behavior: Report sustained luminance over time, thermal throttling and recovery rather than only a brief peak.
failure_modes: brief flash substituted for sustained brightness
cases.claim_limit: A measured result applies only to the named device/mode/test environment.

cases.title: Black level under bright-corner stress

stimulus.pattern: dual bright-corner boxes with center black

cases.expected_behavior: Measure center black while declared bright regions remain active.
cases.claim_limit: Does not qualify contrast under other patterns or rooms.

cases.title: Active dimming and checkerboard contrast
cases.expected_behavior: Measure white/black performance under the specified same-image stress pattern and report active-dimming settings.
failure_modes: cross-pattern ratios presented as same-image contrast
cases.claim_limit: Do not infer local-dimming quality from an ideal backlight model alone.

cases.title: Gamut, color accuracy and color volume by luminance
cases.expected_behavior: Record color space, white point, instrument spectral assumptions and accuracy across the defined luminance levels.
failure_modes: gamut area mistaken for color volume
uncalibrated camera RGB used as colorimeter
cases.claim_limit: Only claims the exact tested display mode and method.

cases.title: PQ EOTF and white-point tracking on a physical HDR display
cases.expected_behavior: Compare encoded input and calibrated absolute luminance/white point at required points; keep calculated PQ reference separate from measured panel output.
failure_modes: PQ equation output mislabeled as measurement
cases.claim_limit: Does not imply DisplayHDR certification unless full CTS performed.

cases.title: Subtitle/local-dimming temporal interaction

stimulus.pattern: constant luminance patch with subtitles toggled on/off

cases.expected_behavior: Measure neighboring patch luminance over subtitle transitions and report transient and steady change.
cases.claim_limit: A simulation cannot establish measured subtitle flicker.

cases.title: Black-to-peak HDR rise-time response
cases.expected_behavior: Record the luminance time series and derive rise time using the pinned method and sampling rate.
failure_modes: nominal refresh rate substituted for measured rise time
cases.claim_limit: Only applies to the tested panel mode and pattern.

cases.title: Motion-blur test against a pinned ClearMR method

stimulus.camera: calibrated high-speed capture or the prescribed apparatus

cases.expected_behavior: Compute the specified clear-to-blurry pixel metric using matched timing, overdrive and camera conditions; preserve raw sequences.
metrics: Clear Motion Ratio under pinned method
failure_modes: refresh rate used as motion-blur proxy
cases.claim_limit: Not an official ClearMR result unless every required test condition is met.

cases.title: Frame cadence, judder and frame-time spikes
cases.expected_behavior: Measure delivered frame cadence and end-to-end display timing; do not use nominal refresh as proof that the source cadence is represented faithfully.
cases.claim_limit: Needs instrumented capture to assert physical presentation timing.

cases.title: Energy per matched visual workload
cases.expected_behavior: Compare candidate and baseline on identical device/workload/output conditions; separate GPU energy from complete system/display input power.
failure_modes: GPU time equated to wall power
cases.claim_limit: No energy improvement claim without meter calibration and matched visual-output gates.

cases.title: Text and interface legibility under scaling
cases.expected_behavior: Use a preregistered text-reading/detection task to verify that candidate scaling/rendering does not reduce task success; record display subpixel configuration and viewing geometry.
failure_modes: image similarity used as legibility proof
cases.claim_limit: No universal accessibility/comfort claim from one cohort.

cases.title: Color-gradient banding and neutral stability
cases.expected_behavior: Report code-value continuity, visible-band proxy and channel neutrality separately; a claimed visual improvement needs blinded/controlled perceptual review.
cases.claim_limit: Synthetic gradients do not establish perceived or physical banding.

cases.title: Linear-light alpha blend reference
cases.expected_behavior: Compare encoded-space blending with a reference that decodes to linear light, blends, then re-encodes; make the declared compositing space explicit.
failure_modes: blending nonlinear codes while claiming linear-light output
cases.claim_limit: Does not establish a specific compositor follows this pipeline.

cases.title: Stale or mismatched display profile negative control
cases.expected_behavior: Mark the evaluation unqualified or require recalibration when profile identity, device identity or calibration validity conflicts.
cases.claim_limit: Synthetic metadata test only; hardware calibration state needs trusted records.

cases.title: Missing or corrupted raw measurement blocks qualification
cases.expected_behavior: Report evidence integrity or applicability as failed/unknown and prevent a candidate's declared pass from becoming independently qualified.
cases.claim_limit: This tests evidence handling, not the physical measurement itself.

cases.title: Frozen workload and oracle integrity negative control

mutations: oracle version changed without manifest version

cases.expected_behavior: The validator detects manifest/corpus drift and reports a distinct integrity failure rather than scoring altered fixtures as the same benchmark.
failure_modes: producer modifies oracle and candidate together
cases.claim_limit: Digest identity protects versioning; it does not authenticate physical truth.
